flows.contact: Need help? Write to us at <link>{email}</link>.
flows.rateLimitedWait: Too many attempts. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
flows.storageBlocked: Your browser is blocking site storage, so this page can't remember your order. You'll still receive your report link by email.
flows.emailMismatch: The two email addresses don't match.

download.started: Your download has started. Look for “ZodiacBlend-Report.pdf” in your downloads.
download.failed: The download didn't start. Please check your connection and try again.
download.rateLimited: Too many downloads in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.

free.metaDescription: Discover your Western sun sign and your Chinese zodiac animal in seconds — free, with a reading for each.

form.title: When were you born?
form.lead: Your birth date is all we need to find your sun sign and your Chinese year animal.
form.emailHint: Saved with your reading. We'll only email you news if you tick the box below.
form.languageHint: Your readings will be written in this language.
form.privacy: Your birth date is used only to find your signs. Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

result.title: Two traditions, one portrait
result.lead: The sign the Sun was crossing on the day you were born, and the animal that guards your Chinese year.
result.announce: Your reading is ready: {sign} and the {animal}.
result.sunCusp: The Sun changed sign on your birthday, so you may be {sign} or {alternative}.
result.yearCusp: The Chinese year changed on your birthday, so your animal may be the {animal} or the {alternative}.
result.exactTime: Your exact birth time decides — the full report calculates it precisely.
result.missingReading: This reading isn't available right now. Please try again later.
result.ctaBody: Add your birth time and place and we calculate your Moon, Ascendant and all four Chinese pillars, then write a personal six-part report you can download as a PDF.

reading.metaDescription: Your personal six-chapter report from the exact moment and place of your birth: Sun, Moon, Ascendant and the four Chinese pillars.
reading.deliveryNote: Ready in minutes · download as PDF
reading.reportLanguage: Your report will be written in {language}. To change the language, use the language switch at the top of the page.
reading.formLead: The more precise your details, the more personal your report.

fields.firstNameHint: Used only to personalise your report.
fields.emailHint: Your report link will be sent to this address.
fields.birthTimeHint: Please be as exact as you can (your birth certificate is best). Your Ascendant and your Chinese hour animal change about every two hours, so a few minutes can change your chart.
fields.countryError: We couldn't load the list of countries.
fields.cityCapitalHint: We've preselected the capital — choose your city if you were born elsewhere.

reading.secureNote: You'll complete the payment on a secure page. Your report starts as soon as it's confirmed.
reading.freeNote: No payment needed with your code — your report starts as soon as you confirm.

timeChoice.title: Which {time} do you mean?
timeChoice.body: On your birth date the clocks went back at your birthplace, so {time} happened twice. Please choose the one on your birth certificate.
timeChoice.first: The first {time} — before the clocks went back
timeChoice.second: The second {time} — after the clocks went back
timeChoice.required: Please choose one of the two times.

gap.title: {time} didn't exist on that date
gap.body: The clocks went forward at your birthplace that day, so the time jumped over {time}. Please check your birth time.
gap.suggestion: Times in the gap are usually recorded as {suggested}.

errors.invalidPlace: We can't calculate a chart for this place. Please choose another city nearby.
errors.payment: The payment service isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.

checkout.title: Complete your order
checkout.bannerBody: This page simulates the payment step for development and testing. No card is needed and nothing is charged.
checkout.unavailableBody: This test payment page is only used in development. Please open your order to complete the payment securely.
checkout.missingOrder: This checkout link is incomplete. Please start again from the order form.
checkout.noTokenTitle: We can't find this order here
checkout.noTokenBody: This order was placed in another browser, or your browser's storage was cleared. Please start a new order from this browser.
checkout.notPayable: This order doesn't need payment any more.

order.retrying: We couldn't reach our servers. Retrying…

noToken.title: Open your report from your email
noToken.body: For your privacy, order details can only be shown in the browser where the order was placed. When your report is ready we email you a personal download link that works on any device.

notFound.title: Order not found
notFound.body: We couldn't find this order. Please check the link, or use the link in the email we sent you.

awaiting.title: Complete your payment
awaiting.body: Your order is reserved. Complete the payment and we'll start your report right away.
awaiting.cancelled: Payment cancelled — you have not been charged. You can complete it whenever you're ready.
awaiting.confirmingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
awaiting.notPayable: This order can no longer be paid. Please refresh the page.

progress.title: Your report is being created
progress.lead: You can stay on this page or come back later — we'll also email you the link as soon as it's ready.

announce.queued: Your report is in the queue.
announce.design: All chapters written. Designing your PDF.
announce.ready: Your report is ready to download.

progress.slow: This is taking a little longer than usual. You can safely close this page — we'll email you when your report is ready.

ready.title: Your report is ready
ready.lead: Your personal <brand>Zodiac Blend</brand> report has been written and designed. Download it now and keep it safe.
ready.emailed: We've also emailed the link to {email}.
ready.keepCopy: For your privacy the file is deleted after {hours} hours. Please save your copy.

failed.title: Your report needs a little more time
failed.body: Something went wrong while preparing your report. Don't worry — your payment is safe, our team has been notified, and we'll email you as soon as your report is ready.

expired.title: This download has expired
expired.body: For your privacy, each report can be downloaded for {hours} hours after it's ready, then the file is deleted.

refunded.title: This order was refunded
refunded.body: The payment for this order was refunded, so the report is no longer available.

abandoned.title: This order was not completed
abandoned.body: The payment was never completed, so this order has been closed. You're welcome to start a new one at any time.

report.title: Your <brand>Zodiac Blend</brand> report
report.lead: Your personal report is ready. Download the PDF and keep it somewhere safe.
report.privacyNote: This link is personal: anyone who has it can download your report, so please don't share it.

missing.title: This link is incomplete
missing.body: The download link seems to be cut off. Please open it again from your email, or copy the whole link into your browser.

invalid.title: This link isn't valid
invalid.body: We couldn't find a report for this link. Please use the most recent email we sent you — a newer email replaces earlier links.

notReady.title: Your report isn't ready yet
notReady.body: We're still preparing it. Please try this link again in a few minutes.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: For your privacy, each report can be downloaded for {hours} hours after it's ready; after that the file is deleted from our servers.
